headline: Flaracle kindling
title: Flaracle | Kindling Seven And Burning Explosions | Palworld Guide
video_script: Flaracle is a Fire Pal added in Palworld one point zero, and it is a top base worker for cooking. It has Kindling level seven, Handiwork level six and Transporting level two. Its partner skill, Burning Future, makes enemies that are burning explode when you hit them, and the blast damages nearby foes. Water attacks are its weakness. Will you catch one? Comment below!
description: Flaracle in Palworld 1.0 has Kindling level seven and Handiwork level six, and its Burning Future makes burning enemies explode.
